literal_meaning: বলা (to say) এবং কওয়া/কহা (to say) – একই অর্থের যুগ্মশব্দ
figurative_meaning_en: Synonymous compound word; to inform or announce, predetermined or already decided
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বিষয়টি আগে থেকেই বলা-কওয়া আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This matter has already been said and settled beforehand.
note: This is a tautological expression emphasizing certainty in speech or decision.
